system_prompt_style.note: Blog post only; no prompt construction described.

env_context_strategy.note: No config or tool list available; git clone into sandbox mentioned but no navigation mechanism described.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: This can be paired with context trimming, which selectively removes tokens such as old tool results or thinking blocks.
context_compaction.note: The passage describes Claude platform context features in prose. It is not clear that Managed Agents uses them by default. The same passage mentions the memory tool.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Decoupling the brain from the hands makes each hand a tool, execute(name, input) → string: a name and input go in, and a string is returned.
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Many brains, many hands

tool_call_format.note: Tool calls are mentioned, but the syntax is not described.

edit_primitive.note: Sandbox can 'edit files' but no edit primitive is described.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: For custom tools, we support MCP and store OAuth tokens in a secure vault.
tool_schema_source.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP is evidenced; the source of built-in tool schemas is not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Claude calls MCP tools via a dedicated proxy; this proxy takes in a token associated with the session.
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a harness (the loop that calls Claude and routes Claude’s tool calls to the relevant infrastructure)
loop_primitives.note: event_driven inferred from the append-only session event log (emitEvent/getEvents).

multi_agent_topology.note: The post says 'brains can pass hands to one another', but it does not describe the default topology.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a session (the append-only log of everything that happened)
short_term_state.note: The session event log is stored outside the context window; this is the closest fit.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: memory tool lets Claude write context to files, enabling learning across sessions.
long_term_memory.note: This is prose about a platform memory tool. Whether it is a default part of Managed Agents is unclear.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a new one can be rebooted with wake(sessionId), use getSession(id) to get back the event log, and resume from the last event.
state_persistence.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

retry_policy.note: The post mentions container reprovisioning when Claude decides to retry; this is step-level, not a task retry policy.

cost_controls.note: The post mentions 'context organization to achieve a high prompt cache hit rate' as something a harness may do; no mechanism is specified.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The harness doesn’t know whether the sandbox is a container, a phone, or a Pokémon emulator.
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Many brains, many hands
execution_isolation.note: The post describes the sandbox as a container provisioned remotely by a hosted service. The harness itself runs outside the sandbox. Customer VPC connection is also possible.

permission_model.note: Credential isolation (a vault plus an MCP proxy) is described, but no action authorisation model is described.

tracing.evidence_quote: the harness writes to the session with emitEvent(id, event) in order to keep a durable record of events.
tracing.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Decouple the brain from the hands

replayability.note: The post describes resuming from the event log, not replaying it.

guardrails.note: Credential isolation from the sandbox is described; it is not a filter or policy.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a hosted service in the Claude Platform that runs long-horizon agents on your behalf
target_domain.note: Git repos and code execution suggest swe is also a target.

open_source.evidence_quote: Managed Agents—our hosted service for long-horizon agent work
open_source.note: The post describes a hosted service; no repo URL is given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: a hosted service in the Claude Platform that runs long-horizon agents on your behalf
